decisions.reason: CISA active exploitation advisory for three Linux kernel CVEs (CVE-2025-39682, CVE-2025-39964, CVE-2026-53266) with federal remediation deadline. Substantive security event with real exploitation claims.

CVE-2025-39964.evidence: CISA confirms active exploitation of race condition in AF_ALG cryptographic socket interface; existed in kernel for 14 years.

CVE-2026-53266.evidence: CISA confirms active exploitation of out-of-bounds write in ebtables SNAT implementation.

CVE-2025-39682.evidence: CISA confirms active exploitation of TLS receive-path logic flaw with zero-length records.
